reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
    State: Oklahoma
    Focus year: 2021

    Question: Can a landlord evict a tenant for criminal activity (including general criminal/illegal
    activity; a specific crime/illegal act; controlled substances; unlawful action causing serious
    physical harm; criminal nuisance)?
*/

% ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
% Basic domain vocabulary
% ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

state(oklahoma).
focus_year(2021).

% Actor roles in relation to a tenant (used by the statute).
under_tenant_control(tenant).
under_tenant_control(household_member).
under_tenant_control(guest).

% ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
% STATUTE TRANSLATIONS (Oklahoma)
% ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

/* [1] 23 OK Stat  23-70 (2021)
   Double damages for willful holding over after end of term, after notice to quit and demand. */
statute_ok_23_70_double_yearly_value_damages_applies(Tenant, Property) :-
    tenancy_ended(Tenant, Property),
    notice_to_quit_duly_given(Tenant, Property),
    demand_for_possession_made(Tenant, Property),
    willfully_holding_over(Tenant, Property).

statute_ok_23_70_damage_multiplier(2).

/* [2] 41 OK Stat  41-8 (2021)
   No notice to quit necessary in listed circumstances. */
statute_ok_41_8_no_notice_to_quit_required(tenancy_termination_specified_in_contract).
statute_ok_41_8_no_notice_to_quit_required(tenant_at_will_commits_waste).
statute_ok_41_8_no_notice_to_quit_required(tenant_by_sufferance).
statute_ok_41_8_no_notice_to_quit_required(no_landlord_tenant_relationship).

/* [3] 41 OK Stat  41-111 (2021)
   Termination notice periods and some holdover consequences (simplified to core thresholds). */
statute_ok_41_111_notice_days_required(month_to_month, 30).
statute_ok_41_111_notice_days_required(tenancy_at_will, 30).
statute_ok_41_111_notice_days_required(less_than_month_to_month, 7).

statute_ok_41_111_definite_term_expires_without_notice(definite_term).

% If tenant remains without landlord's consent after expiration/termination, landlord may
% immediately bring an action for possession and damages.
statute_ok_41_111_may_bring_action_for_possession_on_nonconsensual_holdover(Landlord, Tenant, Premises) :-
    landlord(Landlord),
    tenant(Tenant),
    premises(Premises),
    tenancy_expired_or_terminated(Tenant, Premises),
    tenant_in_possession(Tenant, Premises),
    \+ landlord_consents_to_continued_occupancy(Landlord, Tenant, Premises).

/* [4] 41 OK Stat  41-131 (2021)
   Nonpayment: terminate if unpaid and not cured within 5 days after written notice demand. */
statute_ok_41_131_may_terminate_for_nonpayment(Landlord, Tenant, Premises) :-
    landlord(Landlord),
    tenant(Tenant),
    premises(Premises),
    rent_unpaid_when_due(Tenant, Premises),
    written_notice_of_demand_for_payment_served(Landlord, Tenant, Premises),
    tenant_failed_to_pay_within_days_after_notice(Tenant, Premises, 5).

/* [5] 41 OK Stat  41-127 (2021)
   Tenant duties; relevant here: no qualifying criminal activity and no drug-related criminal activity. */
statute_ok_41_127_8_prohibits_qualifying_criminal_activity(Tenant, Premises) :-
    tenant(Tenant),
    premises(Premises),
    qualifying_criminal_activity_committed_by_or_under_control_of_tenant(Tenant, Premises).

statute_ok_41_127_8_prohibits_drug_related_activity(Tenant, Premises) :-
    tenant(Tenant),
    premises(Premises),
    drug_related_criminal_activity_committed_by_or_under_control_of_tenant(Tenant, Premises).

/* [6] 41 OK Stat  41-132 (2021)
   A/B/C: notice/cure and imminent harm; D: immediate termination for qualifying criminal/drug activity.
   Notes: [7]-[9] are duplicates of [6] in the prompt; encoded once here.
*/

% 41-132(A): if remediable noncompliance and landlord remedies it, landlord may not terminate for that failure.
statute_ok_41_132_a_landlord_may_repair_and_charge_as_rent(Landlord, Tenant, Premises) :-
    landlord(Landlord),
    tenant(Tenant),
    premises(Premises),
    noncompliance_remediable_by_repair_replacement_or_cleaning(Tenant, Premises),
    ten_day_notice_to_remedy_served(Landlord, Tenant, Premises),
    tenant_failed_to_remedy_within_days(Tenant, Premises, 10).

statute_ok_41_132_a_if_landlord_remedies_no_termination_for_that_breach(Landlord, Tenant, Premises) :-
    statute_ok_41_132_a_landlord_may_repair_and_charge_as_rent(Landlord, Tenant, Premises),
    landlord_remedied_breach(Landlord, Tenant, Premises).

% 41-132(B): material noncompliance: notice (>=15 days termination date) with 10-day cure option.
statute_ok_41_132_b_may_terminate_for_material_noncompliance_after_notice(Landlord, Tenant, Premises) :-
    landlord(Landlord),
    tenant(Tenant),
    premises(Premises),
    material_noncompliance_by_tenant(Tenant, Premises),
    notice_served_specifying_acts_and_termination_date(Landlord, Tenant, Premises, TerminationDateDaysOut),
    TerminationDateDaysOut >= 15,
    cure_period_days(10),
    tenant_failed_to_remedy_within_days(Tenant, Premises, 10).

cure_period_days(10).

% 41-132(C): imminent and irremediable harm not remedied promptly after notice -> terminate by immediately filing.
statute_ok_41_132_c_may_terminate_by_immediate_filing(Landlord, Tenant, Premises) :-
    landlord(Landlord),
    tenant(Tenant),
    premises(Premises),
    noncompliance_causes_or_threatens_imminent_and_irremediable_harm(Tenant, Premises),
    tenant_has_notice_of_noncompliance(Tenant, Premises),
    \+ tenant_remedied_as_promptly_as_conditions_require(Tenant, Premises).

% 41-132(D): qualifying criminal activity or drug-related criminal activity -> immediate termination grounds.
statute_ok_41_132_d_ground_for_immediate_termination(Landlord, Tenant, Premises) :-
    landlord(Landlord),
    tenant(Tenant),
    premises(Premises),
    rental_agreement_exists(Landlord, Tenant, Premises),
    (   qualifying_criminal_activity_committed_by_or_under_control_of_tenant(Tenant, Premises)
    ;   drug_related_criminal_activity_committed_by_or_under_control_of_tenant(Tenant, Premises)
    ).

% ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
% Qualifying criminal/drug activity definitions used by 41-127(8) and 41-132(D)
% ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

% A "qualifying criminal activity" is criminal activity that:
% - threatens health/safety/right of peaceful enjoyment of other tenants, OR
% - is a danger to the premises.
qualifying_criminal_activity(Type) :-
    Type = criminal_activity_threatening_health_safety_or_peaceful_enjoyment.
qualifying_criminal_activity(Type) :-
    Type = criminal_activity_danger_to_premises.

% Drug-related criminal activity on or near the premises.
drug_related_criminal_activity(Type) :-
    Type = drug_related_criminal_activity_on_or_near_premises.

% Committed "by tenant, household member, guest, or other person under tenant's control".
qualifying_criminal_activity_committed_by_or_under_control_of_tenant(Tenant, Premises) :-
    tenant(Tenant),
    premises(Premises),
    person_related_to_tenant(Tenant, Person, Relation),
    under_tenant_control(Relation),
    committed_activity(Person, Premises, ActivityType),
    qualifying_criminal_activity(ActivityType).

drug_related_criminal_activity_committed_by_or_under_control_of_tenant(Tenant, Premises) :-
    tenant(Tenant),
    premises(Premises),
    person_related_to_tenant(Tenant, Person, Relation),
    under_tenant_control(Relation),
    committed_activity(Person, Premises, ActivityType),
    drug_related_criminal_activity(ActivityType).

% ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
% Derived right to evict (possession action) for the specific question
% ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

% For this Q, we treat "evict" as: landlord has legal grounds to immediately terminate
% and thus may file an eviction/possession action.
landlord_may_evict_for_criminal_activity(Landlord, Tenant, Premises) :-
    statute_ok_41_132_d_ground_for_immediate_termination(Landlord, Tenant, Premises),
    tenant_in_possession(Tenant, Premises).

% ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
% SCENARIO (facts encoding the question's factual statement)
% ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

% Parties and premises (minimal setup to let statutes apply).
landlord(l1).
tenant(t1).
premises(p1).
rental_agreement_exists(l1, t1, p1).
tenant_in_possession(t1, p1).

% Relationships: the statute covers tenant, household members, guests, and others under control.
person_related_to_tenant(t1, t1, tenant).

% The question lists categories of criminal activity; we encode them all as occurring in the scenario,
% and we map each to one of the statute's qualifying categories.

% (a) "criminal or illegal activity generally"
scenario_activity(t1, criminal_or_illegal_activity_generally).

% (b) "committing a specific crime or illegal act"
scenario_activity(t1, committing_a_specific_crime_or_illegal_act).

% (c) "use, possession, or sale of controlled substances"
scenario_activity(t1, controlled_substances_use_possession_or_sale).

% (d) "an unlawful action causing serious physical harm to another person"
scenario_activity(t1, unlawful_action_causing_serious_physical_harm).

% (e) "criminal nuisance"
scenario_activity(t1, criminal_nuisance).

% Map scenario categories to statute-relevant activity types, and assert that the tenant committed them
% on/near the premises in a way that triggers 41-132(D).

committed_activity(t1, p1, criminal_activity_threatening_health_safety_or_peaceful_enjoyment) :-
    scenario_activity(t1, criminal_or_illegal_activity_generally).

committed_activity(t1, p1, criminal_activity_threatening_health_safety_or_peaceful_enjoyment) :-
    scenario_activity(t1, committing_a_specific_crime_or_illegal_act).

committed_activity(t1, p1, drug_related_criminal_activity_on_or_near_premises) :-
    scenario_activity(t1, controlled_substances_use_possession_or_sale).

committed_activity(t1, p1, criminal_activity_threatening_health_safety_or_peaceful_enjoyment) :-
    scenario_activity(t1, unlawful_action_causing_serious_physical_harm).

committed_activity(t1, p1, criminal_activity_threatening_health_safety_or_peaceful_enjoyment) :-
    scenario_activity(t1, criminal_nuisance).

% Helper that succeeds when the encoded factual statement ("this includes ...") is satisfied:
% i.e., all listed categories are present in the scenario.
scenario_statement :-
    state(oklahoma),
    focus_year(2021),
    landlord(l1),
    tenant(t1),
    premises(p1),
    rental_agreement_exists(l1, t1, p1),
    tenant_in_possession(t1, p1),
    scenario_activity(t1, criminal_or_illegal_activity_generally),
    scenario_activity(t1, committing_a_specific_crime_or_illegal_act),
    scenario_activity(t1, controlled_substances_use_possession_or_sale),
    scenario_activity(t1, unlawful_action_causing_serious_physical_harm),
    scenario_activity(t1, criminal_nuisance).

% ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
% Unused-but-defined predicates referenced by some statute translations (to keep program complete).
% (They are left as facts that can be extended; for this scenario they do not affect the result.)
% ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

tenancy_ended(_Tenant, _Property) :- fail.
notice_to_quit_duly_given(_Tenant, _Property) :- fail.
demand_for_possession_made(_Tenant, _Property) :- fail.
willfully_holding_over(_Tenant, _Property) :- fail.

tenancy_expired_or_terminated(_Tenant, _Premises) :- fail.
landlord_consents_to_continued_occupancy(_Landlord, _Tenant, _Premises) :- fail.

rent_unpaid_when_due(_Tenant, _Premises) :- fail.
written_notice_of_demand_for_payment_served(_Landlord, _Tenant, _Premises) :- fail.
tenant_failed_to_pay_within_days_after_notice(_Tenant, _Premises, _Days) :- fail.

noncompliance_remediable_by_repair_replacement_or_cleaning(_Tenant, _Premises) :- fail.
ten_day_notice_to_remedy_served(_Landlord, _Tenant, _Premises) :- fail.
tenant_failed_to_remedy_within_days(_Tenant, _Premises, _Days) :- fail.
landlord_remedied_breach(_Landlord, _Tenant, _Premises) :- fail.

material_noncompliance_by_tenant(_Tenant, _Premises) :- fail.
notice_served_specifying_acts_and_termination_date(_Landlord, _Tenant, _Premises, _TerminationDateDaysOut) :- fail.

noncompliance_causes_or_threatens_imminent_and_irremediable_harm(_Tenant, _Premises) :- fail.
tenant_has_notice_of_noncompliance(_Tenant, _Premises) :- fail.
tenant_remedied_as_promptly_as_conditions_require(_Tenant, _Premises) :- fail.

% ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
% Answer predicate (deterministic)
% ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

housing_answer(yes) :-
    scenario_statement,
    landlord_may_evict_for_criminal_activity(l1, t1, p1),
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    !.

% ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
% Main entrypoint
% ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: Can a landlord evict a tenant for criminal activity? This includes: criminal or illegal activity generally; committing a specific crime or illegal act; the use, possession, or sale of controlled substances; an unlawful action causing serious physical harm to another person; or criminal nuisance.
